objective: Define the smallest safe append-only coordination-history archive contract without moving or compacting ledger content.
non_goals: No archival or deletion of ledger content
No movement or rewriting of handoff packets
No replacement of canonical rules, UI, probe, implementation, intake, or approval sources

Current live-ledger physical-line and byte counts
